author: c. j. hurtado
title: Evan Stingley places 16th on day two of NCAA Zone E Diving Championships
text:
The University of Nevada, Las Vegas men’s diving team continued its participation in the NCAA Zone E Diving Championship on March 11, with freshman Evan Stingley representing the Rebels at the Wall Aquatic Center in Flagstaff, Arizona.
Stingley competed on platform and finished with an overall score of 610.40, earning him a 16th place finish among the field. The event is part of a multi-day championship that brings together top collegiate divers from across the region.
The NCAA Zone E Diving Championships serve as a qualifying meet for athletes aiming to advance to national-level competition. Performances at this event are critical for divers seeking to secure spots at upcoming NCAA championships.
Competition will conclude Wednesday, with preliminary rounds scheduled to begin at 10:30 a.m. Pacific Time.
The results from this championship will determine which divers move forward in their season and represent their schools at higher levels.
